The Chair would like to spread into the records the provisions of Section 3. Section 3. Rights and Obligations of Witnesses. A witness must answer questions, although his answer may tend to establish a claim against him. However, it is the right of a witness, number one, To be protected from irrelevant, improper or insulting questions and from harsh or insulting demeanor. Not to be detained any longer than the interest of justice require. Not to be examined except only as to matters pertinent to the issue. Not to give an answer which will tend to subject him or her to a penalty for an offense unless otherwise provided by law.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Not to give an answer which will tend to degrade his reputation unless it is to be the very fact at issue or to a fact from which the fact in issue would be presumed. But a witness must answer to the fact of his previous final conviction for an offense. The Chair wishes to emphasize that an answer which may be unsatisfactory is not inherently contemptible. Supreme Court cases have cautioned courts to use the power of contempt with the highest restraint. The Chair wishes to remind the members of this Court as well, including the Presiding Officer himself, who stated that his patience was wearing thin the other day, that we are sitting as Senator judges in a trial. Our rules behoove us to receive and evaluate the evidence with impartiality and due to the often lengthy examination by both parties with utmost patience as well. I wish to also remind the counsel for both parties as well as our fellow senator judges including this representation that while we may rigorously examine witnesses and test the credibility of their testimonies, we must refrain from resorting to a manner of questioning or to making declarations that elicit fear rather than candor. The Chair therefore respectfully requests our distinguished colleagues, the councils for the parties including this representation, to exercise restraint expected of us. Unlike in inquiries in aid of legislation, an answer of I do not know or I do not recall may be extremely frustrating. It's one that we may encounter numerous times in a proceeding such as this. What we can control, however, is how we appreciate and weigh the testimonies and statements delivered before this Court. We owe it to the parties, to the witnesses, and to the institution we represent to conduct the proceedings still with fairness, dignity, and respect in spite and despite our frustration and or disappointment with what the witness may or may not be saying.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: That's a conclusion. I'm not misleading...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Virgil, kindly let Attorney Lindon finish.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Motion to strike. Anong grandstanding?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly let Attorney Lindon finish.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: The prosecution is currently way, way ahead in their pontification, Your Honor. Oh,

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: this terms your honor, please. Pontification, grandstanding. Why can't the defense get away with that, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Allow me. Allow me. Allow me. Counsel, if you may. This is quite a simple presentation of evidence covering merely 205,000. which quite frankly is well within the SAL-N of the Vice President and or her spouse to spend. Only that, Attorney Cabrera, the forensic expert of the prosecution, highlighted this expense as one of his findings in his forensic report. But having said that, again, let the court emphasize, this is well within the SAL-N. If I remember correctly, 88 million of the vice president for attorney Carpio to spend. You have made your point, attorney Virgil. Kindly, kindly, we understand and we get it. But kindly move to your next point already. Without belaboring the point further. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: This is to address the point raised by the defense. Atty. Carpio, being a private individual, is not covered by the requirements of the laws on accountability. Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Honor, I think the prosecution is still responding to the incident. We already moved on.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Move on, counsel. Again, we get the point and that's the context by which the testimony and the witness is testifying. Can I move on, counsel? I

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: can move on, Your Honor, please. If only the defense would agree with what is stated in the law that is not only the vice president but also her spouse that is obligated by law to lead a modest life as stated in the Constitution, Your Honor. Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Honor, the court can take that conclusion, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What conclusion? You have your answer, counsel. They will not. And besides, the witness is not being presented as an expert. to testify as to whether or not that interpretation is correct or accurate. Subject to the appreciation of the senator-judges. Again, the point here is the 205,000 and let's not veer away from it.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: In that case, Your Honor, please, that would be all for cross-examination, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Atty. Virgil. Atty. Lindon, any redirect?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: A few questions on redirect, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, Counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: I will just proceed straight to the point, sir. Magsisinungaling po ba kayo para kay Manases R. Carpio?

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. That's leading, Your Honor. You are on redirect. That's not allowed.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, to abbreviate the proceedings, I think that was the whole point earlier of your cross. Witness may explain himself. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Magsisinungaling po ba kayo para kay Manases R. Carpio?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: I took an oath as a witness and as a lawyer. Hindi po ako magsisinungaling.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Magsisinungaling po ba kayo para kay Sara Z. Duterte?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Hindi rin po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: No further questions, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: And that does not deserve re-cross-examination, Your Honor, please. Move

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: to strike, Your Honor. Oh,

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: that's a manifestation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Move to strike, Your Honor. That's an improper manifestation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Virgil, I will have to strike those remarks.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Suffice it to say that the prosecution manifested that they will not conduct a re-cross in regard to this witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Senator Judge Imee. And happy birthday, by the way. This is your birthday interjection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Maraming salamat, my birthday interjection, presiding judge, and to our witness, attorney. You mentioned that you are a Freemason. Kayo ba ni attorney man sa nasa parehong lodge?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Una po sa lahat, happy birthday po, Madam Senator.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Maraming salamat.

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Paano ko ba sasagot? I am a fellow craft mason ma'am. I think hindi pa po ako full-fledged mason.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Ay hindi pa kayo full-fledged? Pero kung sakali magiging parehong lodge ba kayo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Magkaiba pong lodge po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Magkaibang lodge. Pero magkakilala kayo at the brother mason ang pakay mo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Magkakilala po kami since law school po ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Would you say that it's not out of the ordinary for members of the Masons to hold fellowships and even travel together? Kasi madalas ko silang nagkikita na isang tropa pati sa Ilocos po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Yes po ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: So in your assessment, it is possible, part of the reason why attorney Manz willingly allowed his credit card to be used to cover the bill, because he was among friends, even fellow Mason brothers whom he trusted from a long, long time ago. Nung studyante pa kayo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: I can, I agree with that ma'am. Isa po sa mga dahilan, if I may po na. Siya po ang nag-volunteer din ng gamitin yung credit card niya. Abol niya din po kasi yung points sa credit card.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Tama. Would you have done the same thing? Use your credit card to cover the bill of your old law school classmates and even fellow masons?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Yes po ma'am, subject to reimbursement po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Siyempre. Oo naman. So you would trust, in fact, your brother masons, your former classmates, your old-old friends to reimburse you fairly and honestly, hindi po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Yes, ma'am. Saka hindi naman po ito yung first time na nagpatak-patak po kami for a bill.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Tama, ambag-ambag parate pag malaki lalo ang bill. Talagang gawain ng barkada yan, di ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Was VP Sara personally present nung dinner na yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: Wala po siya, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: And to the best of your knowledge, was there any indication that VP Sara was aware of the transaction involved?

turns.speaker: Atty. Anel Martin S. Antero
turns.text: I wouldn't know, ma'am, but I wouldn't know.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Okay, thank you very much. That will be all. Maraming salamat. Thank you, Presiding Judge.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Imee. Happy birthday again. There being no other Senator Judge who wished to make an interjection. Atty. Anel, maraming salamat po sa inyong panahon, sa inyong pagtestigo at sa pagsagot sa katanungan ng mga kabilang partido at ng Sen. Judge Imee. You are excused, sir. Before we proceed, the Senate President is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Clerk of Court is directed to call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Call call up, members. Sen. Judge Aquino, Sen. Judge Cayetano Alan, Sen. Judge Cayetano Pia, Sen. Judge De La Rosa, Sen. Judge Ejercito, Sen. Judge Estrada, Sen. Judge Go, Sen. Judge Hontiveros, Sen. Judge Lacson, Sen. Judge Lapid, Sen. Judge Legarda, Sen. Judge Marcoleta, Sen. Judge Marcos, Sen. Judge Padilla, Sen. Judge Pangilinan, Sen. Judge Sotto III, Sen. Judge Tulfo Erwin, Sen. Judge Tulfo Raffy, Sen. Judge Villanueva. Senator Judge Villar Camille, Senator Judge Villar Mark, Senator Judge Zubiri, The Presiding Officer, Senator Judge Escudero, The Senate President, Senator Judge Gatchalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 18 Center Judges present, the Chair declares presence of the Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lindon, would you like to call your next witness? Will you be the one handling as well?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel
turns.text: Your Honor, for the next witness, may we request that Justin Nicol B. Gular be recognized, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Justin, call your next witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor. For our next witness, may we call to the witness stand Mr. Chadrin S. Parian?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly situate Mr. Parian to the witness stand. Clerk is directed to administer the oath. Honorable Ridon, who will handle the examination of Mr. Parian?

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: It will be Attorney Robles, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Sir, please raise your right hand. You, Chadrin Parian, do swear that the evidence you shall give in the case now pending between the Philippines and Vice President Saira Zimmerman Duterte shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. So help you God.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Paano niyo po namin kayong gustong i-address? Parang komplikado yung Chad. Chadrin?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Chad na lang po, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Chad. Better. Easier. Ginong Chad. Naunawaan niyo po inyong pinanumpaan kaugnay sa pagbibigay niyo ng inyong testimonya sa harap ng hukumang ito?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you very much. Offer, Attorney Justin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. May we just request the tech to display the offer. Your Honor, we are offering the testimony of Mr. Chadrin S. Parian for the following purposes. Number one, to prove that he and Atty. Manases R. Carpio, are parents of children, that are part of a children's basketball team named Elite Philippines. Number two, to prove the circumstances surrounding the Nike Pavilion Kuala Lumpur credit card charge amounting to 256,882 pesos and 50 centavos. And number three, to disprove the material allegations under Article 2 of the Articles of Impeachment. To identify documents and other matters related to the foregoing, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Ray?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor. Good morning, Atty. Gular.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Good morning, Atty. Ray.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Noted. You may proceed with your direct examination, Atty. Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Proceeding po. Sir Chad, magandang umaga po. For the record, can you please state your name, age, and address?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Ako po si Chadrin Parian, 45 years old, taga Las Piñas City.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Sir, ano po yung nalalaman niyo tungkol sa impeachment case na to kung mayroon man, sir?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Ito po ay impeachment ni VP Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At paano niyo po nalaman na ito ang impeachment case? How do you know about this impeachment case?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Through social media, through the news.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sir, diretsohin ko na po. Bakit po kayo nagtetestigo sa kasong ito?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: I received a subpoena po regarding the...

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sir, may I just request you to speak just a bit louder and closer to the mic? It's okay, it's okay. Can you please repeat your answer to my question, sir?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: I receive a subpoena to testify or be here with regards to the purchases of the Nike shoes in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: You mentioned about purchases of Nike shoes in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. What do you know about that? Purchase of Nike shoes. Kung mayroon man, sir.

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Kasama po ako dun sa pagpunta at pagbili ng mga sapatos ng mga bata.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: May sinabi po kayong pagpunta. Saan po kayo pumunta, sir?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, pumunta po kami sa Malaysia noon to compete. Yung mga kids po may basketball tournament.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At kailan po kayo pumunta sa Malaysia?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: I remember nag-flight po kami is June 11.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And hanggang kailan po kayo o kailan po kayo bumalik sa Pilipinas kung naalala nyo po?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Bumalik po kami ng Pilipinas June 16.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ano po yung pruweba nyo na lumipad po kayo sa Kuala Lumpur at na lumuas kayo galing sa Pilipinas at bumalik kayo sa mga dates na sinabi nyo po?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, nagbigay po ako ng copies ng tickets ko at saka yung egov.ph na Arrival and Departure po dito sa Pilipinas. Plus meron po yung sa Malaysia, imigrasi.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: San po yan, Sir? Sinabi niyo kasi na binigay niyo. I

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: submitted the USB to the Secretariat po ba yan? I'm not familiar with it.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, may we request that the USB provided by the witness be accessed and that the specific Malaysia immigration document and the e-travel be flashed. Unless, of course, The good counsel from the prosecution is willing to stipulate that the authenticity and due execution of the documents mentioned and referred to by our witness and to be able to dispense with the authentication and identification in court.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: If only.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Ray?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: We are willing to stipulate.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Proceed accordingly, Attorney Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you. Sinabi niyo po na pumunta kayo sa Malaysia kasama ng basketball team. Bakit po kayo pumunta sa Malaysia kasama yung basketball team?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, nagkaroon po ng invitation. I think I'm not yung coach namin na mag-compete doon. Okay. And then, yun po. Naglaro po sila ng basketball.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ano po yung nangyari sa... Ano po itong... Bakit po sila naglaro ng basketball sa Malaysia? Medyo confused ko kasi ako eh.

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Ano po eh? Yung mga bata po, they're not in the same school. They do not live in the same communities or cities. Para po siyang selection ng mga bata na through tryouts, nagkasama-sama po kami. So meron pong on the different backgrounds in life. Ganun po ang pagkakaano ko. Yun po yung pagkakasama-sama namin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At ano naman po ang relasyon? At sino-sino po ang mga kasama nyo nung pumunta kayo sa Kuala Lumpur?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, mga parents po, kasama po doon si Atty. Manases Carpio. At

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: ano naman po ang relasyon ni Atty. Manases Carpio sa... Una po, anong pangalan ng basketball team na tinutukoy natin?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Elite Philippines po. Pilipinas po yung naka...

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At ano naman po ang relasyon ni Atty. Manases Carpio sa Elite Philippines basketball team?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Parang po siyang... Co-parent and manager na rin po ng team namin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At ano po yung relasyon nyo sa basketball team na yan?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: I treat him as attorney as a co-parent with our kids.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So how do you consider your relationship with attorney Manases Carpio?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Nung sa Malaysia po, attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: In Malaysia. In relation to the basketball team po?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Yeah, I treat him as a co-parent po. Eventually, naging kakaibigan na rin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sinabi nyo kanina na pumunta kayo as a co-parent sa Malaysia ng isang children's basketball team. Ano po yung nangyari sa tournament na yun?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, sa kaputin awa po ng Diyos, nag-champion yung mga bata.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Nag-champion ang mga bata. At ulitin po natin, ano po yung composition ng basketball team na to?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, hindi po siya school or it's more of a selection team.

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: As premised by the question, it's already answered, Ron.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Move on, Atty. Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, pagkatapos po na nag-champion yung mga bata, ano po yung nangyari? Kung naalala niyo po.

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, natural po na after mag-champion, may celebration po. Siyempre, bibigyan mo ng doing for their, they're doing a good job. Ipapasyal namin yung mga bata kasi yung mga iba dun po sa amin, first time lang po bumiyahe.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At saan niyo pinasyal yung mga bata at yung ibang sinabi niyo na first time lang nagbiyahe?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: I remember po, after the game, after the championship and awarding, on June 15, pagkatapos naman namin magkaroon ng awarding, natapos yung awarding, pumunta po kami sa downtown Malaysia, parang near Kuala Lumpur, yung parang Chinatown street na maraming kainan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At pagkatapos kayong kumain, sir, ano po yung nangyari kung may roadman?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, after po noon, may mga parents na bumili ng mga... namasyal doon. Tapos nagkayayaan po pumuntang mall, which is the Pavilion Mall po ba yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At nung pumunta kayo sa Pavilion Mall, ano po yung nangyari? Ano yung nangyari kung naalala nyo?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Siyempre po, namasyal yung mga bata. Kami po sumusunod-sunod lang. Tapos eventually po, nagkayayaan yung mga bata sa tumingin ng sapatos.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sinabi niyo po na mga bata eventually tumingin ng sapatos. Saan po ito? Yung yayaan niyo ng pagtingin ng sapatos?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Marami po silang pinuntahan na shops eh. May mga specialty stores po doon sa pavilion. Then, natapos po doon sa Nike. Doon po sila nagtagal.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Puntaan po natin yung sinabi niyong Nike. Ano po yung nangyari sa Nike store na ito?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, tumitingin-tingin lang po sila ng mga sapatos yung mga bata. Then eventually, parang nakita ko sila na naging na-excite sila kasi parang Narinig ko na pumili na sila ang sizes sila at saka gusto nilang sapatos.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Pagkatapos nito, anong nangyari sa pagpipili ng mga sapatos? Kung naalala nyo po.

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Well, I personally saw the kids choose their own shoes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And after all the kids chose their own shoes, ano po yung nangyari kung naalala nyo?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Yun po. Tapos na po. Final na po. Nakita ko po, binayaran na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At sinabi niyo po na nakita na binayaran yung mga sapatos. Sino po yung nagbayad kung naalala niyo?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Si Atty. Carpio po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ano po yung ebendensya niyo dito kung mayroon man?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: I was near the counter when it happened, when he made the purchase.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At ano po yung ginawa niyo nung nakita niyo yun?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: Natuwa po ako kaya kinunang ko ng photo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. At daladala niyo po ba ang litrato na tinituloy niyo ngayon?

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: It's also in the USB, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: In the USB. Your Honor, may we just ask that this be flashed, Your Honor, that photo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Tech is instructed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, apologies. I have just been informed that the flash drive is not with the tech.

turns.speaker: Chadrin S. Parian
turns.text: I gave one to the... But I have two copies here, sir. Sorry.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.text: Maraming salamat po, ginuong takapamahal ng hukom. Sa pagkat kanina po kasi sabi niyo, mamaya na lang kami magtanong. Eh, matatapos na po pala. Pwede na po pala ngayon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pwede na po. Mukhang ganun na nga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Your Honor. Maraming salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, you may proceed, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Meron lang po akong tanong sa prosekyusyon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Honorable Ridon or Atty. Ray or Atty. Ligutan? Yung

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: kanina pong naka... Atty. Ray, with

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: your indulgence,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Honorable Ridon, can you remind me to recognize you before we adjourn?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Ganda kapon po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Opo. Kanina po...

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Parang sa pagkakaintindi ko po, inyo pong sinasaksak sa kapuso at kapamilya at kapatid nating mga kababayan na talagang dapat mabuhay ng simple ang lahat ng public official. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Opo kasi yan po yung tinatakda ng batas at ng saligang batas po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Yan po. Opo. Sa tingin niyo po ba, diyan po sa camera.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Meron po ba dyan mga nakakotse na mga halagang 16 million to 22 million?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Wala po akong personal nakakilala.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Diyan po sa mga kasama po ninyo, mga mababatas. Diyan po sa katabi nyo, meron po ba dyan nakakotse ng Mercedes Benz, wagon, kulay itim?

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Wala po akong alam na may

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Mercedes Benz.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Wala

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: po kayong alam. Siguro po dapat una natin tingnan yung mga kasama natin dahil may kasabihan nga po tayo. Tingnan muna natin yung mga kasama natin bago tayo kumahol. Sapagkat alam nyo po, pagka ganyan na ipinipilit natin ng isang bagay tapos yung mga kasama nyo dyan,

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: ang

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: alam ko pa dyan, meron mga membro din dyan ng public information. Nakasama ko, nagsusulong ng FOI, Freedom of Information Bill. Sana po eh huwag na natin itong pahirapan pa. Makapag-buycam na kami para kung sino man po talaga yung nabubuhay na politiko dito sa bansang ito na nabubuhay ng sobra-sobra at walang kasimple-simple, huwag na po tayo maglokohan dito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Sana alamin na natin talaga kung sino talaga dito yung nabubuhay talaga ng may 16 million, may 22 million, may maraming bahay dito, dito po sa bayan natin. Para naman po yung halagang 250,000 eh. Nung kailan lang po gumastos ako 900,000. Gusto nyo po, imbestigahan nyo kung saan ko dinala. Ito lang po, yung mga pinagbabaril doon sa Tacloban, ginastosan ko ng 300,000. Yung pinagbabaril po dyan sa South Cotabato, sa Eskwelahan, ginagastosan ko po ngayon ng 340,000. Imbestigahan nyo po. Yun lang po, maraming salamat.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Duly noted. What is the pleasure of the Honorable Ridon who was signifying earlier his intent to speak?

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Yun po nga pagse-serve lang, Your Honor, ng subpoena kung sakaling sa Sabado pa ho maglalabas ng listahan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sheila, how will that be?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: We will file that by email, Your Honor, on Saturday

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No, the service of subpoena is being asked. Will you require a subpoena or will you be presenting the witness yourself?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Yes, we will require a subpoena, Your Honor. We will also provide the email address of the witnesses for the e-service of the subpoena.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: it will

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: be serviced by email?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Finally, Atty. Sheila, I know you have been very prudent with the court's time with the withdrawal of some of the witnesses. And by asking and agreeing for unstipulations, may the court know how many more witnesses... You can give me a cap. You don't have to give an exact number, Attorney Sheila. You will be presenting.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Without going into the details, we still present...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Without naming the witnesses, of

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: course.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. We intend to present around 8 to 10 witnesses, Your Honor. 10 would be the maximum, but around those figures, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Because given ASEAN, the ASEAN meeting, we won't have any trial on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday next week. That's 16, 17, 18. We have given you an advisory with respect to that. Our next trial date will already be on November 19 and 20 for the whole day. November 30 will be a holiday and we have not yet issued a calendar for December. Because, sorry, before that week. The following week of November 23 to 27, perhaps after the wee hours of 28, will be devoted for the budget deliberations, plenary budget deliberations of the Senate. The following week, Monday, will be November 30.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: December 1 will be a Tuesday. December 2 is Pasay City Day which we have not yet decided if we will follow depending on the Senate President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If he wants to be liked more, he may follow it. If he does not care about that, he might not follow it. So we will issue the calendar for December in the week of November 19 and 20 next week.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: As the

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Court has done so in the past. Announcing the schedule of trial dates for the subsequent month in the current month. Would that be okay for the parties?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Understood, Your Honor. Just one last clarification. We no longer have a hearing on November 23 because in the advisory...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No, no

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: more.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Originally, the advisory stated we will still have a hearing in the morning. of the 23rd up to 2, but no more.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you for that information, Your Honor, so that we can also inform our witness that we intended initially to present on the 30th. So

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: hopefully, Atty. Sheila, we will be able to finish a witness on the 20th kasi malaki yung gap eh.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Secondly, kindly give enough witnesses to cover the two whole days of trial so that we don't

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Need to adjourn or cancel a trial kung sakasakaling mabilis yung witness na ipe-present po ninyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Understood, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay, thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you very much. Any other matters the counsels wish to take up?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Nothing more from our end.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: There being none, ay, hindi na talagang bumalik.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Trial is adjourned until, happy birthday again, Senator Aimee. Trial is adjourned until November 19.
